target_database_schema:
CREATE TABLE dim_customer (
        customer_key INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        customer_name VARCHAR(25),
        customer_address VARCHAR(40),
        customer_phone CHAR(15),
        account_balance NUMERIC,
        market_segment CHAR(10),
        nation_key INTEGER NOT NULL,
        nation_name CHAR(25),
        region_key INTEGER NOT NULL,
        region_name CHAR(25),
        customer_tier VARCHAR(20)
    );

    CREATE TABLE dim_supplier (
        supplier_key INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        supplier_name CHAR(25),
        supplier_address VARCHAR(40),
        supplier_phone CHAR(15),
        account_balance NUMERIC,
        nation_key INTEGER NOT NULL,
        nation_name CHAR(25),
        region_key INTEGER NOT NULL,
        region_name CHAR(25)
    );

    CREATE TABLE dim_product (
        product_key INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        product_name VARCHAR(55),
        manufacturer CHAR(25),
        brand CHAR(10),
        product_type VARCHAR(25),
        size INTEGER,
        container CHAR(10),
        retail_price NUMERIC,
        avg_supply_cost NUMERIC,
        total_avail_qty INTEGER
    );

    CREATE TABLE dim_date (
        date_key DATE PRIMARY KEY,
        year INTEGER,
        quarter INTEGER,
        month INTEGER,
        day INTEGER,
        day_of_week INTEGER,
        month_name VARCHAR(20),
        is_weekend BOOLEAN
    );

    CREATE TABLE fact_order_line (
        order_key BIGINT NOT NULL,
        line_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
        customer_key INTEGER NOT NULL,
        product_key INTEGER NOT NULL,
        supplier_key INTEGER NOT NULL,

        order_date_key DATE NOT NULL,
        ship_date_key DATE NOT NULL,
        commit_date_key DATE NOT NULL,
        receipt_date_key DATE NOT NULL,

        quantity NUMERIC,
        extended_price NUMERIC,
        discount NUMERIC,
        tax NUMERIC,

        return_flag CHAR(1),
        line_status CHAR(1),
        ship_instructions CHAR(25),
        ship_mode CHAR(10),

        revenue NUMERIC,
        profit NUMERIC,
        discount_amount NUMERIC,
        tax_amount NUMERIC,

        days_to_ship INTEGER,
        days_to_commit INTEGER,
        days_to_receipt INTEGER,

        is_late_shipment BOOLEAN,
        is_returned BOOLEAN,

        PRIMARY KEY (order_key, line_number),

        FOREIGN KEY (customer_key)
            REFERENCES dim_customer(customer_key),

        FOREIGN KEY (product_key)
            REFERENCES dim_product(product_key),

        FOREIGN KEY (supplier_key)
            REFERENCES dim_supplier(supplier_key),

        FOREIGN KEY (order_date_key)
            REFERENCES dim_date(date_key),

        FOREIGN KEY (ship_date_key)
            REFERENCES dim_date(date_key),

        FOREIGN KEY (commit_date_key)
            REFERENCES dim_date(date_key),

        FOREIGN KEY (receipt_date_key)
            REFERENCES dim_date(date_key)
    );

table_generation_queries.query: SELECT c.c_custkey AS customer_key, c.c_name AS customer_name, c.c_address AS customer_address, c.c_phone AS customer_phone, c.c_acctbal AS account_balance, c.c_mktsegment AS market_segment, c.c_nationkey::INTEGER AS nation_key, n.n_name AS nation_name, n.n_regionkey::INTEGER AS region_key, r.r_name AS region_name, CASE WHEN c.c_acctbal >= 5000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN c.c_acctbal >= 1000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN c.c_acctbal >= 0 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS customer_tier FROM public.customer c JOIN public.nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN public.region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey;

SELECT s.s_suppkey AS supplier_key, s.s_name AS supplier_name, s.s_address AS supplier_address, s.s_phone AS supplier_phone, s.s_acctbal AS account_balance, s.s_nationkey::INTEGER AS nation_key, n.n_name AS nation_name, n.n_regionkey::INTEGER AS region_key, r.r_name AS region_name FROM public.supplier s JOIN public.nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN public.region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey;

SELECT p.p_partkey AS product_key, p.p_name AS product_name, p.p_mfgr AS manufacturer, p.p_brand AS brand, p.p_type AS product_type, p.p_size AS size, p.p_container AS container, p.p_retailprice AS retail_price, COALESCE(AVG(ps.ps_supplycost), 0) AS avg_supply_cost, COALESCE(SUM(ps.ps_availqty), 0) AS total_avail_qty FROM public.part p LEFT JOIN public.partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, p.p_container, p.p_retailprice;

WITH dates AS (SELECT o_orderdate AS date_key FROM public.orders WHERE o_orderdate IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT l_shipdate FROM public.lineitem WHERE l_shipdate IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT l_commitdate FROM public.lineitem WHERE l_commitdate IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT l_receiptdate FROM public.lineitem WHERE l_receiptdate IS NOT NULL) SELECT date_key, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_key)::INTEGER AS year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM date_key)::INTEGER AS quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_key)::INTEGER AS month, EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_key)::INTEGER AS day, EXTRACT(DOW FROM date_key)::INTEGER AS day_of_week, TO_CHAR(date_key, 'Month') AS month_name, CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM date_key) IN (0, 6) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_weekend FROM dates;

SELECT li.l_orderkey AS order_key, li.l_linenumber AS line_number, o.o_custkey::INTEGER AS customer_key, li.l_partkey::INTEGER AS product_key, li.l_suppkey::INTEGER AS supplier_key, o.o_orderdate AS order_date_key, li.l_shipdate AS ship_date_key, li.l_commitdate AS commit_date_key, li.l_receiptdate AS receipt_date_key, li.l_quantity AS quantity, li.l_extendedprice AS extended_price, li.l_discount AS discount, li.l_tax AS tax, li.l_returnflag AS return_flag, li.l_linestatus AS line_status, li.l_shipinstruct AS ship_instructions, li.l_shipmode AS ship_mode, li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount) AS revenue, (li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) - (ps.ps_supplycost * li.l_quantity) AS profit, li.l_extendedprice * li.l_discount AS discount_amount, li.l_extendedprice * li.l_tax AS tax_amount, (li.l_shipdate - o.o_orderdate) AS days_to_ship, (li.l_commitdate - o.o_orderdate) AS days_to_commit, (li.l_receiptdate - o.o_orderdate) AS days_to_receipt, CASE WHEN li.l_shipdate > li.l_commitdate THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_late_shipment, CASE WHEN li.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_returned FROM public.lineitem li JOIN public.orders o ON li.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN public.partsupp ps ON li.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND li.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey;
